when

    AND (to_string($message.application_name) == "windows_rdp"
    OR to_string($message.event_code) == "4647")
    
then
    remove_multiple_fields(pattern: "^winlogbeat_.*");
    remove_from_stream(name: "Remote Desktop Authentications");

end

Processes messages documenting a successful Remote Desktop Session disconnect

source.@value:
rule "Remote Session Disconnect Messages"

when
    has_field("gim_event_type")
    AND to_string($message.event_outcome) == "success"
    AND contains(to_string($message.gim_event_type), "session disconnect")
    AND lookup_has_value("remote-desktop-session-monitoring", to_string($message.user_session_id))
    
then
    lookup_remove_string_list(
        lookup_table: "remote-desktop-session-monitoring",
        key: to_string("active_rdp_sessions"),
        value: [to_string($message.user_session_id)]
    );
    
    lookup_add_string_list(
        lookup_table: "remote-desktop-session-monitoring",
        key: to_string("inactive_rdp_sessions"),
        value: [to_string($message.user_session_id)]
    );
        
end

source.@value:
rule "Remote Desktop Logon Messages - Add destination_ip"

when
    has_field("gim_event_type")
    AND has_field("destination_hostname")
    AND to_string($message.event_outcome) == "success"
    
    AND ((contains(to_string($message.gim_event_type), "logon")
    AND NOT contains(to_string($message.gim_event_type), "special logon"))
    
    OR (contains(to_string($message.gim_event_type), "session disconnect") 
    OR contains(to_string($message.gim_event_type), "session reconnect")))

then
 let destination_ip = lookup_value(
        lookup_table: "remote-desktop-session-monitoring-dns", 
        key: to_string($message.destination_hostname)
        );
    
    set_field("destination_ip", to_string(destination_ip));
    
end

pipeline "Remote Desktop Authentications"
stage 2 match pass
rule "Remote Desktop Logon Messages - Add destination_ip"
rule "Remote Desktop Logon Messages - Replace source_hostname"
stage 9 match either
rule "Remote Desktop Processing Cleanup Rule"
stage 3 match pass
rule "Remote Desktop Logoff Messages"
rule "Remote Desktop Logon Messages"
rule "Remote Session Disconnect Messages"
rule "Remote Session Reconnect Messages"
end
